rule: Classify semantic concerns, not whole files. Preserve causal properties in the narrowest modern upstream owner.
invariant: UPSTREAM STRUCTURE + WORKSTATION SEMANTICS + MINIMUM NECESSARY FIRST-PARTY SEAMS + NO CAPABILITY REGRESSION FOR PURITY

research_baselines.note: Historical research SHAs remain provenance only. H-079 requires a fresh upstream fetch and one newly pinned exact SHA before each downstream code-change cycle.

entries.target: turn admission + LLM-request projection owned by a first-party Hermes adapter
entries.rationale: The file contains multiple independent seams with different destinations; it must not be classified as one REMOVE unit.

concerns.current_behavior: Binds MessageEnvelope, WorkIntent, canonical_task_id/run_id and repeatability state in the old conversation-loop prologue.
concerns.required_ordering: After Hermes establishes session/task/turn identity and before compaction, auxiliary/provider work, or any route-sensitive action.
concerns.replacement: generic turn_admission lifecycle boundary; Workstation adapter translates ingress into MessageEnvelope/WorkIntent
concerns.sunset_condition: direct prepare_turn_work import is removed only after timing parity is proven

concerns.current_behavior: Projects a wire-only conversation copy, injects authenticated durable handoff, and removes already-covered work_execute history without mutating persisted transcript.
concerns.required_ordering: After canonical transcript exists and immediately before provider request construction/execution.
concerns.sunset_condition: remove direct seam after shadow projection parity

entries.target: split causal execution seams across generic pre-dispatch, post-tool observation and persistence-disposition contracts
entries.rationale: prepare_mutation, post-result observation and durable internal persistence have different causal positions and cannot share one REMOVE disposition.

concerns.semantic_owner: generic tool dispatch lifecycle -> Workstation mutation journal
concerns.current_behavior: Persists mutation=uncertain and persisted=unknown before an authorized external side effect leaves the process.
concerns.required_ordering: FINAL args -> authorization/guardrails passed -> checkpoint -> REAL I/O. Never before final args/authorization and never after I/O.
parity_tests: blocked calls create no uncertain mutation
process death after I/O before ACK cannot cause blind retry
concerns.sunset_condition: direct prepare_mutation call removed only when the generic hook occupies the same causal boundary

concerns.current_behavior: Records dispatched effect/result observation after execution.
concerns.required_ordering: Raw terminal result available before conversation spill/truncate/persistence projection.
concerns.sunset_condition: post_tool_call proves raw terminal parity

concerns.semantic_owner: Workstation procedure trace / Experience Compiler observer
concerns.current_behavior: Captures the raw tool result before model-facing persistence/truncation and makes it available to Experience Compiler via raw_result_ref in TransitionSample.
concerns.required_ordering: Immediately after tool terminal result and before spill/truncate/tool-message projection.
parity_tests: Experience Compiler can access raw results for learning when needed
concerns.sunset_condition: raw-result parity proven
concerns.observed_gap: Experience Compiler now accesses raw tool results via TransitionSample.raw_result_ref field that references sanitized raw results in ArtifactStore, enabling learning with sufficient fidelity while maintaining security

concerns.current_behavior: Internal compiled steps do not flush as independent conversational turns; the durable runner owns checkpoints/persistence.
concerns.required_ordering: Persistence decision applies before assistant/tool message flush for each internal compiled step.
concerns.sunset_condition: direct durable_execution_active branch removed after owner-managed persistence parity

entries.target: retire run_agent.py as Workstation integration owner; move semantics to decomposed upstream owners plus Hermes adapter
entries.rationale: The downstream monolith contains high-value Workstation semantics, but preserving the monolith would defeat upstream decomposition.

concerns.current_behavior: Classifies the whole assistant tool-call batch as EXECUTE/REQUIRE_COMPILE/REQUIRE_HUMAN before dispatch.
concerns.required_ordering: After the model proposes the complete tool batch and before any member is dispatched.
parity_tests: discovery reads can pass while repeated mutations compile
concerns.sunset_condition: run_agent batch policy removed after turn_tool_round admission parity
concerns.observed_gap: Normal turn batches are admitted once by agent/turn_tool_round.py and carry an explicit admitted marker into the executor. Direct callers that bypass the turn owner are admitted once by the executor fallback boundary.

concerns.semantic_owner: generic scoped executor context -> Workstation deterministic dispatcher
concerns.current_behavior: Carries deterministic execution context, operational references and mutation/effect lineage into tool dispatch.
concerns.required_ordering: Bound before admitted deterministic dispatch and released after terminal observation.
concerns.replacement: generic execution scope/context consumed by executor and adapter
concerns.sunset_condition: run_agent-owned execution context disappears

concerns.current_behavior: Prevents provider/tool/browser/auxiliary routes forbidden by operational authority.
concerns.required_ordering: Policy established at turn admission and consulted before every primary, auxiliary and tool route.
concerns.sunset_condition: route enforcement no longer depends on run_agent Workstation branches

entries.rationale: Workstation finalization is an acceptance gate, not a fire-and-forget observer.

concerns.current_behavior: Checks canonical task/run, WorkPlan/WorkItems, evidence, verification, acceptance and procedure trace before admitting completion.
concerns.required_ordering: Before canonical DONE/terminal commit; rejection must prevent completion.
concerns.sunset_condition: direct Workstation finalizer import removed after admission can veto terminal commit

entries.target: generalize upstream two-phase acceptance into TaskCompletionAdmission providers
entries.rationale: Modern upstream already proves the prepare-outside-txn/revalidate-inside-txn/record-before-DONE pattern for PR acceptance.

concerns.current_behavior: Workstation acceptance must participate in the canonical completion transaction.
concerns.required_ordering: prepare outside write txn -> snapshot owner/run/state -> begin txn -> revalidate snapshot -> record receipt -> terminal DONE update.
concerns.replacement: PRAcceptanceProvider + WorkstationAcceptanceProvider behind one generic admission chain
concerns.sunset_condition: kanban_db has no Workstation-specific import

entries.target: BrowserControlBroker/controller routing plus Workstation-owned Browser semantics
entries.rationale: Upstream now owns controller routing/identity/dispatch/fail-closed; Workstation should retain task/page/native-runtime semantics.

concerns.current_behavior: Routes browser_* calls to the Workstation Chromium path with fail-closed BrowserTask semantics.
concerns.required_ordering: Resolve exact session/task/principal lane before dispatch; bound-but-unavailable must fail closed.
concerns.replacement: register WorkstationBrowserController with upstream broker and route through browser_extension_router
concerns.sunset_condition: generic browser_tool contains no Workstation route conditional
concerns.observed_gap: The generic registry handler now routes through browser_extension_router; the Workstation adapter registers a provider that attaches WorkstationBrowserController to BrowserControlBroker for the exact Desktop session lane.

concerns.current_behavior: Adds Workstation-owned BrowserTask/artifact/reference semantics to generic Browser calls.
concerns.required_ordering: After controller result, before domain observation is committed.
concerns.sunset_condition: generic browser_tool returns generic result while adapter owns Workstation projection
concerns.observed_gap: WorkstationBrowserController now handles domain-specific processing for browser_extract_items via _process_extracted_items_durably, moving artifact storage, kanban persistence, and result shaping from tools/browser_tool.py to the Workstation adapter.

concerns.current_behavior: Workstation runtime supports capabilities beyond the broker built-in set (console/extract/images/vision/extensions/rich readback).
concerns.required_ordering: Capabilities must be negotiated/registered before schema exposure and dispatch.
concerns.replacement: broker capability registry for built-in + registered capabilities
concerns.sunset_condition: no if-workstation capability list in broker

entries.target: transform legacy Python loopback router into WorkstationBrowserController/adapter
entries.rationale: The native Electron runtime remains; the bespoke Hermes-side routing layer should shrink as the upstream broker becomes the routing owner.

concerns.current_behavior: Bridges Hermes browser calls through loopback HTTP to the Electron runtime.
concerns.required_ordering: Single authoritative execution path during migration; mutation shadow path must never dispatch.
concerns.sunset_condition: legacy Hermes route is deleted after controller authority switch
concerns.observed_gap: The legacy loopback transport and workstation_routed_browser_handler remain for direct compatibility callers and focused parity tests, but generic browser_tool dispatch no longer selects them as the normal authority. Remove after remaining direct callers migrate and controller parity covers their domain behavior.

entries.rationale: Forced Workstation Browser schemas should become unnecessary when the registered controller declares availability.

concerns.current_behavior: Forces Browser schemas into Desktop sessions.
concerns.required_ordering: Schema assembly must consult bound controller capability before model tool definitions are finalized.
parity_tests: Desktop browser schemas remain visible when routable
offline bound lane does not advertise false capability
concerns.sunset_condition: model_tools has no Workstation browser import

entries.rationale: Modern plugin context supports tool registration; work_execute is explicitly not a core tool.

concerns.current_behavior: Hard-codes work_execute into a generic upstream-owned toolset.
concerns.required_ordering: Plugin/tool registration completes before toolset/schema discovery.
parity_tests: work_execute remains available in first-party Desktop
concerns.sunset_condition: toolsets.py has no Workstation tool name

entries.rationale: Modern upstream mounts plugin dashboard routers; Workstation API ownership need not live in the generic web server.

concerns.current_behavior: Generic web_server owns Workstation resources, event projection and cockpit endpoints.
concerns.required_ordering: Router must be mounted in every Desktop/headless mode that currently exposes these surfaces.
concerns.sunset_condition: generic web_server contains no Workstation route implementation

entries.rationale: User text is not authority; origin/trust/session provenance cannot be replaced by pre_llm_call prose.

concerns.current_behavior: CLI stamps content with origin, authority and session provenance before run_conversation.
concerns.required_ordering: Trusted ingress metadata must exist before turn admission and any authority-sensitive work.
concerns.sunset_condition: cli.py no longer imports workstation.contracts

entries.rationale: Route authorization is a generic operational authority primitive, not intrinsically Workstation-specific.

concerns.current_behavior: Central policy guards primary/auxiliary/browser/terminal/tool routes for the active turn.
concerns.required_ordering: Published at turn admission; consulted before every route and mutation route.
concerns.sunset_condition: Workstation only produces policy; Hermes core owns generic enforcement

entries.rationale: First-party Obsidian-compatible Markdown vault engine model tool integration.

concerns.current_behavior: Provides vault_search, vault_read, vault_write, vault_append, vault_backlinks, vault_graph.
concerns.required_ordering: Tool execution time.
concerns.sunset_condition: none

entries.rationale: First-party Workstation model tools exposing journal, policy, and contracts inspection.

concerns.current_behavior: Exposes workstation extension inspection tools.
concerns.required_ordering: Tool execution time.
concerns.sunset_condition: none

entries.rationale: First-party Workstation work_execute tool driving compiled durable batch execution.

concerns.current_behavior: Executes compiled durable work batches through work_execute.
concerns.required_ordering: Tool execution time.
concerns.sunset_condition: none

entries.rationale: Persistent native WebContentsView lifecycle is not equivalent to renderer plugin panes.

concerns.current_behavior: Bootstraps persistent Electron Chromium session, control server, BrowserTask state, CDP, parking, takeover, transfer and IPC.
concerns.required_ordering: Must initialize at native main-process lifecycle before renderer-only plugin surfaces can depend on it.
concerns.sunset_condition: reevaluate only when upstream exposes equivalent generic native-view lifecycle

entries.target: one narrow typed Workstation IPC bridge
entries.rationale: Privileged native BrowserTask control must cross preload safely.

concerns.current_behavior: Exposes typed privileged operations required by the native browser runtime.
concerns.required_ordering: Bridge exists before renderer invokes native browser lifecycle/control.
concerns.sunset_condition: reevaluate only when upstream native SDK provides equivalent safe typed IPC

entries.target: generic Plugin SDK contributed pane/workspace routing
entries.rationale: Presentation can likely move to upstream pane/workspace primitives even while the native runtime remains first-party.

concerns.current_behavior: Automatically opens the Workstation Browser beside the correct chat/session.
concerns.required_ordering: Event routing must preserve visible-session ownership and never hijack background sessions.
concerns.sunset_condition: remove Workstation-specific preview routing after UI parity
